$comment: Every cam here is a 24/7 YouTube livestream facing EAST over the Atlantic, so a sunrise is a 'solar' view and a sunset an 'antisolar' view.

sky_regions are [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame (0,0 = top-left). They keep the sky and drop the flagpole, palms, pier, beach, water and the burned-in text overlays. They were drawn from real 1280x720 frames (Elbo: the 2026-10-06 sunrise frames; Deerfield: live frames pulled from the uw-frame worker on 2026-10-06).

beaches[].lat/lon repeat config/locations.ts; distance_mi is the great-circle distance from that beach's pin to the cam, rounded to 0.1 mi. lib/sunCamsConfig.test.ts keeps both in lockstep with locations.ts.
credit is stored with every observation and the ingest route rejects any other string. Elbo Room gave the owner permission to use its stream as long as it is credited.

cams.note: A PTZ camera: it pans between presets, and the horizon sits anywhere from y=0.27 to y=0.46. The sky region is therefore only the top slice that is sky in every pose.
